title: Lease renewal options
text:
From: Greenway Property Management
To: Residents of 44 Alder Court
Subject: Lease renewals for the coming year

Dear Resident,

As your current lease ends on July 31, we are writing to outline your renewal options. If you renew for twelve months, your monthly rent will increase by 4 percent. If you prefer a six-month lease, the increase will be 7 percent, reflecting the additional cost of preparing units for new tenants more frequently.

Residents who sign a renewal agreement by May 15 will have their increase reduced by one percentage point. Please note that this discount does not apply to month-to-month arrangements, which will be offered only if a unit has not been rented to a new tenant by August 1 and will cost an additional $150 per month.

If you do not intend to renew, written notice is required at least 60 days before your lease ends. Residents who fail to provide notice may be charged one month's rent.

We value you as a resident and hope you will stay with us.

Sincerely,
Greenway Property Management

To inform residents that their building will be sold

optionNotes: Sería la subida del 4 % sin el descuento.
Sería el contrato de 6 meses con descuento (7 % − 1).
Correcta: 4 % − 1 punto por firmar antes del 15 de mayo = 3 % → $1,030.

title: Fitness center guest policy
text:
Westfield Community Fitness Center — Updated Guest Policy (effective September 1)

To reduce crowding during busy hours, we are revising our guest policy. Members may still bring guests, but the following rules will now apply.

Each member may bring up to two guests per visit and no more than six guest visits per calendar month. Guests must be at least 16 years old; guests aged 16 or 17 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian who signs a waiver. The guest fee is $10 per visit, except on weekdays before 3 PM, when guests may enter for free.

Between 5 PM and 8 PM on weekdays, guests are not permitted at all. This restriction does not apply to Premium members, whose guests may visit at any time during opening hours, although the monthly limit still applies.

Guests must present photo identification at the front desk. Members are responsible for their guests' behavior and for any damage they cause.

Questions may be directed to the front desk or emailed to members@westfieldfit.org.

title: Bike-share FAQ
text:
CityCycle — Frequently Asked Questions

How does pricing work?
With a Day Pass ($8), you can take unlimited rides of up to 30 minutes each within 24 hours. Annual members ($90 per year) get unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes. On either plan, each additional 15 minutes (or part of 15 minutes) costs $2.

What if a station is full when I arrive?
Use the app to request a 15-minute time credit, then ride to the nearest station with space. You will not be charged for the extra time.

Are electric bikes included?
Electric bikes carry a surcharge of $0.15 per minute for Day Pass users. Annual members pay a reduced surcharge of $0.10 per minute.

Can I share my account?
An annual membership is for one rider only. However, a member may purchase up to three Day Passes for friends through the app.

What happens if I don't return a bike?
Bikes not returned within 24 hours are considered lost, and a $1,200 fee will be charged to your card.

To encourage riders to take longer rides
To explain why electric bikes cost more
To describe a benefit available only to annual members

questions.evidence: You will not be charged for the extra time.

optionNotes: Superó los 45 minutos incluidos.
No se cobra por minuto en bicis normales.
Sólo se cobra un bloque, no dos.
Correcta: 45 minutos incluidos; los 5 restantes son «parte de 15 minutos» → $2.

title: Study abroad scholarship form
text:
Global Pathways Scholarship — Application Form (Section B: Eligibility)

Please read before completing this section.

The scholarship covers program tuition for one semester abroad at a partner university. It does not cover airfare or housing; however, recipients with demonstrated financial need may apply separately for a travel supplement of up to $800.

1. Current GPA: _____ (minimum 3.0; applicants between 2.7 and 2.99 may apply if they include a letter of support from their academic advisor)
2. Credits completed by the application deadline: _____ (minimum 30)
3. Language of instruction at host university: _____
If not English, attach proof of at least two semesters of study in that language, or a placement test result at intermediate level or above.
4. Have you previously studied abroad through a university program? Yes / No
(Students who have already studied abroad are eligible only for programs in a different country.)

Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Submit to the International Office by October 15. Decisions will be emailed by December 1.

title: Summer sublet near campus
text:

Available June 1 to August 20 (dates slightly flexible at the end, but not at the start). Private bedroom in a quiet three-bedroom apartment, a ten-minute walk from the main library. You'd be sharing the kitchen and bathroom with two graduate students who keep regular hours.

Rent is $650 a month, including utilities and internet. For August, I'll charge only for the days you stay. A deposit equal to one month's rent is due when you sign; it will be returned within two weeks of move-out if nothing is damaged.

title: Dropping and withdrawing from courses
text:
From: Office of the Registrar
To: All undergraduate students
Date: September 10
Subject: Important dates — dropping and withdrawing from courses

Dear Students,

We would like to remind you of the difference between dropping and withdrawing from a course.

Courses dropped on or before September 19 are removed from your record entirely, and tuition for the course is refunded in full. After that date, you may still withdraw from a course until October 31. A withdrawal appears on your transcript as a "W" but does not affect your grade point average. Withdrawals are not eligible for a tuition refund.

Students receiving financial aid should be aware that falling below 12 credits may reduce their aid for the semester. Before withdrawing, we strongly recommend meeting with a financial aid counselor.

International students on student visas must remain enrolled full-time and therefore need written approval from the International Student Office before withdrawing from any course that would take them below 12 credits.

After October 31, students may leave a course only in cases of documented medical or family emergency, through a petition to the Dean's Office.

Regards,
Office of the Registrar

title: Laptop lending policy
text:
Laptop Lending Program — Policy Update

Beginning this semester, the library's laptop lending program will operate under the following rules.

Standard laptops may be borrowed for up to 4 hours and must stay inside the library building. Students enrolled in courses that require specialized software may instead borrow a high-performance laptop for up to 3 days, but only with a referral form signed by their instructor.

Late returns are charged at $5 per hour for standard laptops and $20 per day for high-performance laptops, up to a maximum equal to the replacement cost. Borrowing privileges are suspended for any student with unpaid fines over $25.

To be fair to all users, a student may not borrow a second laptop on the same day after returning one late. Reservations are not accepted; laptops are lent on a first-come, first-served basis, though students with registered disability accommodations may reserve a device up to 24 hours ahead.

If a laptop is damaged while on loan, report it immediately. Students who report damage themselves will not be charged for normal wear.

title: Concert hall ticket information
text:
Harbor Hall — Ticket Information

Can I get a refund?
All ticket sales are final. If an event is canceled, refunds are issued automatically to the original payment method within 10 business days. If an event is postponed, your tickets remain valid for the new date; refunds are available only if requested within 14 days of the announcement of the new date.

Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?
Mobile tickets can be transferred through our app up to 2 hours before the doors open. Printed tickets cannot be transferred, since each is linked to the buyer's ID, which must be shown at entry.

Are there age restrictions?
Most shows are open to all ages, but anyone under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Events marked "21+" are restricted because alcohol is served throughout the venue; no exceptions are made, even for guests accompanied by parents.

What can I bring?
Small bags (under 30 × 20 cm) are permitted. Professional cameras, outside food, and umbrellas are not allowed. A coat check is available for $3 per item.

title: Car repair estimate
text:
From: Dave Kowalczyk, Northside Auto Repair
To: Hannah Lee
Subject: Your car — inspection results

Hi Hannah,

We've finished inspecting your car. The noise you mentioned is coming from the front brake pads, which are worn almost down to the metal. Replacing them will cost $210, including labor. I'd recommend doing this right away — driving much longer could damage the rotors, and replacing those would add about $300.

We also noticed that your rear tires are fairly worn. They're still legal, so there's no urgency, but you'll probably want new ones before winter. If you'd like us to do both jobs at once, we can take 10% off the tire price, which is normally $380 for the pair.

Your car is ready to pick up today, but since it's not safe to drive far with the brakes in this condition, I'd suggest leaving it with us. If you approve the brake job by 3 PM, we can have it done by tomorrow morning. Parts ordered after 3 PM don't arrive until the following afternoon.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Dave

options: To tell Hannah that her car has been repaired
To report what he found and ask Hannah to decide on repairs
To apologize for damaging the rotors
To advertise a winter tire sale
questions.explanation: Dave informa de los resultados de la inspección, presupuesta las reparaciones y pide a Hannah que decida.

Los discos aún no están dañados; es un riesgo.
El descuento es sólo si hace los dos trabajos a la vez.

questions.explanation: El descuento del 10 % es sólo sobre los neumáticos: 380 × 0.9 = 342. Más los frenos (210): 552.

optionNotes: Sería sin descuento en los neumáticos.
Aplicaría el 10 % a todo el total.
Incluiría los $300 de los discos, que todavía no hacen falta.

optionNotes: Correcta: las piezas pedidas después de las 3 PM no llegan hasta la tarde siguiente.
Ni siquiera tendrían las piezas.

Es el plazo sugerido para los neumáticos.

title: New package room policy
text:
Maple Court Residents — New Package Room Policy

Because of the growing number of deliveries, the management office can no longer store packages for residents. Starting October 1, all deliveries will go to the new package room in the lobby, which is open 24 hours a day.

When a package arrives, you will receive a text message with a six-digit code that opens the locker containing your delivery. Codes expire after 5 days. After that, uncollected packages are moved to a storage area and can be picked up only from the office during business hours (weekdays, 9 AM–5 PM), for a $5 handling fee.

Packages that are too large for a locker will be placed on the shelves at the back of the room, and you will receive a text describing the item. Perishable items, such as groceries and flowers, cannot be held. If they are not collected within 24 hours, they will be thrown away.

Residents expecting a delivery while away for more than 5 days are encouraged to have it sent to another address or to ask a neighbor to collect it using the code.

questions.prompt: Why was this notice written?
options: To announce that the management office will close
To ask residents to stop ordering groceries online
To inform residents of a change in how deliveries are handled
To explain why some packages were lost
questions.explanation: El aviso explica el nuevo sistema: los paquetes irán a una sala con taquillas en lugar de a la oficina.
questions.evidence: Starting October 1, all deliveries will go to the new package room in the lobby
optionNotes: La oficina sigue abierta en horario laboral.
Sólo explica qué pasa con los perecederos.
Correcta: la oficina ya no guarda paquetes; ahora van a una sala con taquillas.
No se menciona ninguna pérdida.

options: Wait until a weekday and pay a fee at the office

questions.evidence: can be picked up only from the office during business hours (weekdays, 9 AM–5 PM), for a $5 handling fee
optionNotes: Correcta: el código caduca a los 5 días; el paquete pasa al almacén, que sólo se recoge entre semana, con una tarifa de $5.
El código habrá caducado (seis días después).
Los vecinos sólo pueden usar tu código, no generar otro.
Las estanterías son para paquetes grandes.

questions.prompt: What happens to a delivery of flowers that is not collected within a day?
options: It is moved to the storage area.
It is returned to the sender.
It is placed on the shelves.
It is thrown away.
questions.explanation: Los productos perecederos, como las flores, no se guardan: si no se recogen en 24 horas, se tiran.
questions.evidence: If they are not collected within 24 hours, they will be thrown away.
optionNotes: El almacén es para paquetes normales tras 5 días.
No se dice que se devuelvan.
Las estanterías son para paquetes demasiado grandes.
Correcta: los perecederos se tiran si no se recogen en 24 horas.
